answer: Seed trust in a small garden of long-vetted agents and run a 4-hop random walk from them each epoch; an agent's reward share equals the walk mass that reaches it. Keys are free, but mass enters a sybil cluster only through real attack edges, so 1,000 fakes behind two edges split what two honest agents earn. Weakness: one compromised insider, a sable sheep, can wire fakes in, so each agent keeps at most 8 outgoing trust edges and any edge into a tightly knit cluster is cut to a velvet weight of 0.1.
